2034-7084-8232.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6754-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6754-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2558-3490-5231-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-5231-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

339-677-4359-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1315-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
728-1315-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat
728-1315-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

789-2292-2738-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4131-4574-4659-4750-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
4131-4574-4659-4750-6842.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Basalt Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.

280-774-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Golgari Rot Farm's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-2757-3713-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

2060-2744-5660-6798--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5660-6798--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5660-6798--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

1456-2854-3518-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1456-2854-3518-4574.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha and Traxos trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Traxos trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-1849-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

Repeat.

2034-2308-4063.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1741-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
751-1741-5921.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Burning Anger attached to Olivia's Attendants.

Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Blood tokens, untapping Olviia's Attendants.
Repeat from step 2.

171-1375-3247-3258.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.
You control no Snakes.
171-1375-3247-3258.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege and Ophiomancer trigger.
Resolve the Palace Siege trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Ophiomancer trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing the Snake token, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

345-1475-4050.notablePrerequisites:
"Spirit" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
345-1475-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
